title: Average guy vs guy who's *actually* growing

head: The first 10 minutes
l: Checks his phone in bed for 47 minutes
r: Phone charges in the kitchen. He just gets up.

head: When he gets bored
r: Sits with it. His best ideas show up there.

head: When he gets rejected
r: "What would I do differently next time?"

head: Friday night
l: Same couch, same game, same snacks
r: Gym at 6. Out with the boys at 9.

head: Same 24 hours. *Different defaults.*
sub: You don't need more discipline. You need better automatic choices.
